# FluidLiteArk
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/arks/FluidLiteArk.sol)

**Inherits:**
[ArkWithWithdrawalRequest](../ark-with-withdrawal-request.md)

**Title:**
FluidLiteArk

Ark contract for managing WETH by staking it into Lido stETH and
depositing the stETH into a FluidLite (ERC4626) vault

On board, WETH is unwrapped to ETH, submitted to Lido (stETH), and the
resulting stETH is deposited into the vault. Withdrawals redeem stETH
from the vault and exit either through the Lido withdrawal queue
(requestWithdrawal / claimWithdrawal) or via a swap (withdrawUsingSwap).


## State Variables
### wrapper
Address recorded at construction for the FluidLite ETH vault
wrapper. Currently assigned but unused: boarding stakes ETH into
Lido stETH and deposits stETH directly into the vault rather than
routing through this wrapper.


```solidity
IEthVaultWrapperV2 public immutable wrapper
```


### vault
The ERC4626-compliant vault this Ark interacts with


```solidity
IERC4626 public immutable vault
```


### weth
WETH token address used for wrapping/unwrapping ETH


```solidity
IWETH public immutable weth
```


### steth
StETH token address used for wrapping/unwrapping ETH


```solidity
ISteth public immutable steth
```


### withdrawalQueue
The withdrawal queue used for requesting withdrawals


```solidity
IWithdrawalQueue public immutable withdrawalQueue
```


### WITHDRAWAL_FEE

```solidity
uint256 constant WITHDRAWAL_FEE = 5
```


### withdrawalRequestId
The request id for the withdrawal


```solidity
uint256 public withdrawalRequestId
```


## Functions
### constructor

Constructor to set up the FluidLiteArk


```solidity
constructor(
    address _wrapper,
    address _vault,
    address _weth,
    address _steth,
    address _withdrawalQueue,
    ArkParams memory _params
)
    ArkWithWithdrawalRequest(_params, 15);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_wrapper`|`address`|Address of the FluidLite wrapper|
|`_vault`|`address`|Address of the vault|
|`_weth`|`address`|Address of the WETH token|
|`_steth`|`address`|Address of the StETH token|
|`_withdrawalQueue`|`address`|Address of the withdrawal queue|
|`_params`|`ArkParams`|ArkParams struct containing necessary parameters for Ark initialization|

### _withdrawableTotalAssets

Internal function to get the total assets that are withdrawable

Returns only the WETH currently held directly by this Ark. The vault
position cannot be redeemed synchronously: exiting requires a
keeper-initiated requestWithdrawal through the Lido withdrawal queue
(claimed later) or withdrawUsingSwap, so it is not counted here.


```solidity
function _withdrawableTotalAssets() internal view override returns (uint256 withdrawableAssets);
```

### _board

Boards WETH by staking it into Lido stETH and depositing into the vault

Unwraps WETH to ETH, submits the ETH to Lido (receiving stETH), then
deposits the stETH into the FluidLite ERC4626 vault. Reverts if the
received stETH is insufficient for the vault deposit.


```solidity
function _board(uint256 amount, bytes calldata) internal override;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of WETH to deposit|
|`<none>`|`bytes`||

### _harvest

Internal function for harvesting rewards

This function is a no-op as FluidLite vaults automatically accrue interest


```solidity
function _harvest(bytes calldata)
    internal
    pure
    override
    returns (address[] memory rewardTokens, uint256[] memory rewardAmounts);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bytes`||

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`rewardTokens`|`address[]`|Empty array as there are no separately harvestable rewards|
|`rewardAmounts`|`uint256[]`|Empty array as there are no separately harvestable rewards|

## Errors
### InvalidWrapperAddress
Thrown when the supplied wrapper address is the zero address


```solidity
error InvalidWrapperAddress();
```

### InvalidWETHAddress
Thrown when the supplied WETH address is the zero address


```solidity
error InvalidWETHAddress();
```

### AssetMustBeWETH
Thrown when the Ark's configured asset is not the supplied WETH address


```solidity
error AssetMustBeWETH();
```

### InvalidStETHAddress
Thrown when the supplied stETH address is the zero address


```solidity
error InvalidStETHAddress();
```

### InvalidWithdrawalQueueAddress
Thrown when the supplied Lido withdrawal queue address is the zero address


```solidity
error InvalidWithdrawalQueueAddress();
```

### InvalidAuthData
Thrown when board authorization data is malformed


```solidity
error InvalidAuthData();
```
